Because of significant changes to the level design, progress from earlier versions is no longer carried over, and you’ll start the demo from the beginning. We’re sorry for the inconvenience.Bug fixesMinor UI tweaksWe hope you enjoy the updated demo! If you run into any bugs or have feedback, please let us know. Every bit of it helps us improve the game.Thank you for playing!

events.title: Face the Puzzle: Masked Journey – Play the Demo at Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Face the Puzzle: Masked Journey is joining Steam Next Fest, and the free demo is live now!It is a cozy, atmospheric, sokoban-like puzzle game where every mask changes how you interact with the world. Push objects, move machinery as one, reveal hidden paths, and activate switches. Press every button, solve every puzzle, and light the candle.In the demo, you can try 20 handcrafted levels, with about 30-60 minutes of playtime.The full game launches in November 2026 with 100+ handcrafted levels. events.title: Face the Puzzle: Masked Journey is coming November 26, 2026!
events.summary: The wait is almost over!We’re excited to announce that Face the Puzzle: Masked Journey will officially launch on November 26, 2026, on Steam.Prepare to step into a mysterious journey where every puzzle brings you closer to uncovering what lies behind the mask. Add it to your Steam wishlist and get ready for the journey!See you on November 26!
